research_notes: Re-verified with scripts/gmaps_detail2.js against the live Google Maps listing: name, rating 4.8, 22 reviews, address, phone, hours all match manifest.

Google 'service mentions' on the listing (from reviews): patio tile installation (3), master bathroom remodel (2), drywall repair (2), tile backsplash installation (2), attention to detail (5), efficiency (3), quality work (3), punctuality (3), responsive (2), professional manner (3). Used these to write real service cards.

Listing confirms 1 negative (1-star) review exists alongside the positive ones (author 'Miami Writer', complains the job was left unfinished). Overall rating (4.8/22) already reflects this; not hidden, just not quoted verbatim since it is not one of the curated positive quotes used for social proof.

WebSearch found a real Thumbtack profile: 'Alex Anosov Handyman and Tile installer' (Boca Raton), full name Aleksandr Anosov, described as premium tile installation for luxury properties, 15 years in business, 4 employees, background checked, rate $60/hr with a 2-hour minimum booking. This is the ONLY verifiable real pricing found and is used as-is (no invented prices).

No email found after checking: Google Business 'Info' tab (none shown, only 'Add website'/'Add missing information'), no Instagram/Facebook profile found via WebSearch (name+city searches for personal contractor accounts did not surface one; manifest noted this is also hard to verify due to doxxing-risk search blocking), no Yelp/Angi/HomeAdvisor profile tied specifically to this name+address (other 'Alex' contractors in Boca Raton found but not confirmed to be the same person/business), no linktree or booking page.
Decision: outreach channel = phone call only (cta). ig_url/ig_handle fields reused per playbook rule for 'no social network at all' case: point to the Google Maps listing, label 'Google'.

Language: English. Reviews, business name and Google listing are all in English; no evidence of Spanish-language operation. Primary language = en, content.json is bilingual (en default, es toggle) per DESIGN.md.
